source.label: Local MLX experiment records

metricDefinitions.label: Functional recovery
metricDefinitions.definition: Localized survival with final mass between 40 and 130, a final/pre-injury mass ratio between 0.75 and 1.25, post-injury motion of at least one cell, and a post/pre motion ratio of at least 0.25.
metricDefinitions.calculationSummary: Count passing trials within each genotype and injury level, then divide by 100.

caveats: The candidate was selected using separate search conditions, but this is computational evidence rather than a proof of general biological regeneration.
The observed advantage is sharply bounded: Genesis 001 recovered at 5% centered damage but not at 7.5% or 10%.

evidenceFlow.title: Search and selection
evidenceFlow.detail: A seeded 1,024-candidate parameter search produced 243 preliminary passers; 2,916 multi-condition trials selected candidate 942.

evidenceFlow.title: Locked held-out validation
evidenceFlow.detail: Six hundred damaged trials crossed genotype, injury level, unseen phase, rotation, and noise seed exactly once.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent reconciliation
evidenceFlow.detail: All 600 condition keys were unique, aggregates exactly matched the raw rows, maximum lesion calibration error was 0.000016 percentage points, and minimum undamaged control mass retention was 99.32%.

methods.code:
Acceptance: Genesis 001 recovery ≥ 90% and canonical recovery ≤ 10% at 5% centered damage; every undamaged control retains ≥ 95% mass.
Observed: 100%, 0%, and 99.32%, respectively.
Decision: accepted.
